This is the transition area that brings players from [[Guild Wars Prophecies]] into [[Guild Wars Eye of the North]].

==Getting there==
Enter the [[crevasse]] that [[spawn]]s in [[North Kryta Province]] during the [[What Lies Beneath]] quest or after the completion of that quest, [[I Feel the Earth Move Under Cantha's Feet]] or [[Hole of Istan]].

==Quests available==
*[[The Beginning of the End]] (automatically acquired after the [[Encounter in the Depths]] [[cinematic]])
